answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 556 Country: India Title: Is it permissible in Islam to eat or drink the leftovers of non-Muslim friends who consume alcohol? Question: I m a student and study in a college. I have my friends who are non muslim.they all drink wine.mostly,and in my college there is few muslim.approximately four or five in which i know only 2 of them. So I cant survive in the colege without the friendship of non muslim boys.and they start sharing in my food whenever they come.and eat a little my food and leave remains food for me.and sometime they take my tea or cold drink and drink a litle and then return me. and i dont know what i do i drink that remaining drink or not because they mostly drink wine.it shariyat allaowed me to drink or eat the remaining food or drink of those person or not.and please tell me what i do. if this thing is not allowed in Islam? Answer ID: 556 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 515=498/B) There is no matter in showing tolerance and morality towards non-Muslims. Yes, one should not make them bosom friends and should not share secrets. As far as the matter of their leftover food or drink is concerned, the ruling is that the leftover of every human being is tahir (clean): وسور الآدمي طاھر It means that the leftover of man is tahir whether he/she is drunkard or abstainer. But, you should not use the leftover of a person who drinks tea or shares food just after drinking. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
